Incident classified as privacy breach under GLBA. SAR filed to document internal access violation and ensure regulatory awareness.

data.narrative_summary: Attempt detected to extract sensitive customer data (SSN, DOB, account details) via unauthorized query request during backlog triage. Request was made under guise of case review but sought bulk PII export. All access attempts logged and blocked. No evidence of successful data exfiltration. Related tools were not authorized in admin context, indicating potential policy circumvention attempt.

Audit user permissions for case review roles
Enhance monitoring for anomalous data queries
